title: Eligible & Not-Eligible Final Verdict Barrier Contract

eligibleBarrier.rule: ELIGIBLE verdict is strictly prohibited unless all mandatory rules pass AND rulebookCompleteness.isComplete is true AND amendmentChain.amendmentSearchStatus is CURRENT_CHAIN_VERIFIED.
eligibleBarrier.reasonTemplate: Recruitment rulebook is incomplete. Unresolved rule families: {unresolvedFamilies}. Final eligibility verdict is prohibited.

notEligibleSafetyBarrier.rule: Candidate cannot be disqualified under a base rule (e.g. base age max) if a potential override rule family (e.g. AGE_RELAXATION) is UNRESOLVED for their category.
notEligibleSafetyBarrier.reasonTemplate: Age ({age}) exceeds base maximum limit ({baseMax}), but official age relaxation rulebook is UNRESOLVED for category {category}. Disqualification prohibited until relaxation truth is verified.
